newsitem.title: JAPAN: KDD shares down on weak profits, rate cut.
newsitem.headline: KDD shares down on weak profits, rate cut.

text.p: Shares in Kokusai Denshin Denwa Co Ltd (KDD) slipped on Friday morning, dragged down by the weaker half-year profits it unveiled on Thursday and its announcement of a cut its rates for international phone calls, traders said.
The share price of KDD, Japan's biggest international telecommunications firm, had lost 240 yen to 9,020 yen by 0103 GMT. Volume was 25,500 shares.
On Thursday, KDD said its parent current profits for the six months to September 30 declined to 14.49 billion yen from 17.74 billion yen a year ago.
It also said it planned to cut its rates for international calls by an average 5.1 percent, effective from November 23.
The rate reduction will slash KDD's sales by three billion yen in the 1996/97 business year, KDD president Tadashi Nishimoto told a news conference on Thursday.
